updates.title: OS - Thread Creation and Management
updates.description: Complete documentation on thread creation and management with pthreads, including create/join/detach/cancel flows, worker pool lifecycle, synchronization patterns, and thread-safe coordination with mutex and condition variables.

updates.title: OS - Threading Models
updates.description: Complete documentation on threading models, including many-to-one, one-to-one, and many-to-many mappings, model trade-offs, scheduling behavior, and practical runtime mapping examples.

updates.title: OS - Thread Concepts
updates.description: Complete documentation on thread concepts, thread vs process, thread lifecycle, thread models (many-to-one, one-to-one, many-to-many), user threads, kernel threads, thread synchronization, thread safety, and thread pools.

updates.title: OS - Process Synchronization
updates.description: Complete documentation on process synchronization, race conditions, critical sections, mutual exclusion, semaphores, deadlock, starvation, synchronization algorithms (Peterson's, Bakery, Dekker's), monitors, message passing, and read-write locks.

updates.title: OS - Inter-Process Communication (IPC)
updates.description: Complete documentation on inter-process communication mechanisms including pipes, FIFOs (named pipes), message queues, shared memory, semaphores, signals, sockets, IPC comparison, and best practices for process communication.

updates.title: OS - Process Creation and Termination
updates.description: Complete documentation on process creation (fork), process execution (exec family), process waiting (wait, waitpid), process termination (exit), process hierarchy, zombie processes, orphan processes, and best practices for process lifecycle management.

updates.title: OS - Context Switch
updates.description: Complete documentation on context switching, process state save/restore, context switch overhead, switching between processes and threads, hardware support, and performance optimization techniques.

updates.title: OS - Scheduling
updates.description: Complete documentation on CPU scheduling, algorithms (FCFS, SJF, Priority, Round-Robin, MLFQ), preemptive vs non-preemptive scheduling, scheduling criteria, and practical implementation examples.

updates.title: OS - States and Lifecycle
updates.description: Complete documentation on process states (new, ready, running, waiting, terminated), state transitions, state diagrams, preemption, and process lifecycle management.

updates.title: OS - Process Concepts
updates.description: Complete documentation on process vs thread, process vs program, PCB (Process Control Block), process states, process attributes, process hierarchy, and process lifecycle.

updates.title: OS - Operating System Architecture
updates.description: Complete documentation on kernel space vs user space, system calls, libraries, drivers, OS layers, memory protection, interrupts, and file system architecture.

updates.title: OS - Types of Operating Systems
updates.description: Complete documentation on monolithic OS, microkernel, exokernel, hybrid, real-time OS, embedded, and distributed operating systems.

updates.title: OS - History and Evolution
updates.description: Complete documentation on the evolution of operating systems, batch systems, time-sharing, multiprogrammed systems, and modern operating systems.

updates.title: OS - Introduction and Basic Concepts
updates.description: Complete documentation on what is an operating system, main functions, interface between hardware and software, abstractions.
